description: Ors a flag bit into one object field and sets a second field to four when a global equals ten, then writes three fixed constants into globals and sets a state global to two. Several subroutine calls run before and after these writes.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:15BA

description: Reads one byte from the global table at an index formed from a register argument, doubles it, and adds the incoming 16-bit word to it. The sum is returned to the caller.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:15D8
name: dispatch_command_byte_handler
description: Branches on an incoming command byte to one of many handlers that toggle flag bits, reset sequencing globals and load timing constants. For other values it walks a byte stream until a 255 end marker, mapping 254 to 13 and passing each byte to a subroutine.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:1B16
name: toggle_flag_byte_and_notify
description: Flips the lowest bit of the byte at the pointer supplied in a register, then passes that same pointer to a subroutine.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:2098

description: Stores 29 at offset 54 of one object, then calls subroutines and stores 30 at the same offset of a second object followed by 29 on a third. The pattern is a fixed alternation with subroutine calls between the writes.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:20BC
name: halt_in_endless_loop
description: Calls one subroutine and then spins in an endless loop with no exit, so the routine never returns.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:20CC
name: toggle_status_bit_after_call
description: Calls a subroutine and then flips the lowest bit of a status byte reached through a stored global pointer.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:20DE
name: wait_until_word_is_zero
description: Clears a global and then spins while the 16-bit input word stays nonzero. The routine returns only when that word reads zero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:2106
name: clear_mode_and_init_timers
description: When a mode global is neither zero nor four it is cleared, a flag bit is dropped on a second object and a subroutine is called. It then clears the top bit of a status byte and writes 28 into three offsets of the object.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:213E
name: show_end_text_and_halt
description: Sets the lowest bit of a status byte on the object, calls several subroutines and then loops forever. The referenced text THE END suggests this is the final screen halt.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:2230
name: copy_block_then_poll_loop
description: For inputs below 32 it initialises a few fixed bytes, copies a six-longword block between two addresses and then loops forever toggling a flag. Otherwise it compares a table entry with a global and, when they differ, stores the new value and calls subroutines.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:2282
name: call_twice_then_halt
description: Calls two subroutines and then spins forever in an endless loop.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:232C
name: copy_position_words_reset_flags
description: Clears a flag bit on one object and sets one on another, writes 1000 into a timer field of the second, and copies two 16-bit words from the first object to the second. A field at offset 54 is then set to 0 and 1 with subroutine calls between the writes.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:239A
name: set_shifted_field_copy_word
description: Sets a global to one, updates a byte field at offset 13 by OR-ing it with a shifted copy of itself, and copies a 16-bit field from one object to two others. It also clears a flag bit on one of the target objects and zeroes two globals.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:23C4
name: combine_field_shift_and_copy
description: Updates a byte field at offset 13 by OR-ing it with a shifted copy of itself, then copies a 16-bit field into two other objects. It clears a flag bit on one object and zeroes two globals.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:23FA
name: search_triplet_table_for_byte
description: Walks a table of three-byte records that ends at a minus-one marker and returns as soon as the third byte of a record equals the input byte.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:2418
name: store_byte_and_advance_counter
description: Writes an input byte into a table at the current counter position and stores a derived value into a separate byte, which is zero below eight and the counter minus six otherwise. The counter is then advanced by one.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:2446
name: remove_entry_from_byte_table
description: Searches a byte table for the value in a register. When it is found the following entries are shifted down one place, the counter is decremented and a second byte is lowered when nonzero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:248C
name: shift_field_and_copy_word
description: Calls a subroutine, then updates a byte field at offset 13 by OR-ing it with a shifted copy of itself and copies a 16-bit field into two other objects. It clears a flag bit on one target and zeroes two globals.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:2494
name: clear_flags_and_call_subroutine
description: Clears bit 4 of a global flag byte and the lowest bit of a status byte on the object, then calls a subroutine.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:24B0
name: init_object_fields_and_flags
description: Sets a state variable to one, clears the lowest status bit of the object and zeroes a field at offset 13. It then writes 65 and 66 into a byte at offset 3 of two objects, with a subroutine call between the writes.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:24B4
name: init_object_fields_and_flags
description: Repeats the routine before it: sets a state variable to one, clears the lowest status bit and zeroes a field at offset 13 of the object, then writes 65 and 66 at offset 3 of two objects.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:2508

description: Checks the header for the four-character MCP tag, reads the size fields, allocates an output buffer through a library call and fills a 256-entry lookup table. It then decodes a bit stream of literal and back-reference codes into the buffer and stores a status code.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:2528
name: program_blitter_copy_rows
description: Writes the blitter first and last word masks, control registers, modulo values and pointers, then steps through rows setting the source, destination and size for each pass. Subroutine calls run between passes.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:2554
name: initialise_record_table_entries
description: Writes the words 10 and 160 at the start of each 24-byte record and sets a byte at offset five to four, repeating until a subroutine returns zero. A second loop steps through fifteen positions per row, calling subroutines and toggling a flag each pass.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:26E6
name: copy_longword_block_then_loop
description: Stores its argument, branches on the value 19 and copies six longwords from one table to another. It then toggles a flag and loops forever, busy-waiting on a counter of fifteen each pass.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:28C2
name: free_allocated_blocks_loop
description: Calls the system memory free routine through the exec library base once for each count from a register down to zero. The loop has no other work.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:28E2
name: convert_bitplanes_to_chunky
description: Reads bits from four bitplane words for each pixel, combines them into an index through a 16-entry table and stores the resulting bytes into output buffers. Two source words are read per plane and the same pattern repeats across each row.

name: convert_bitplanes_to_chunky
description: Repeats the bitplane-to-chunky conversion of the preceding routine: it gathers plane bits for each pixel, maps the combined index through a 16-entry table and writes the bytes to output buffers.

name: allocate_buffers_and_convert_bitplanes
description: Allocates three memory blocks through the exec library, storing each returned pointer, then runs the bitplane-to-chunky conversion over the source words. The conversion walks the rows and writes index bytes to the output buffers.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:297C
name: build_nibble_lookup_tables
description: Fills a 16-entry table with the sum of the nibbles of each source word, then builds a second 16-entry table of indices by repeatedly picking the largest remaining value and marking it used. Four longwords are cleared at the end.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:29F0
name: remap_pixels_through_colour_table
description: Walks each pixel of four bitplane words and compares its stored byte with the next byte, replacing it with a table value when the difference is within a tolerance. The four plane words of each row are then rebuilt from the table bits and stored back.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:2AA0
name: reset_state_after_subroutine
description: Calls a subroutine and then sets a state variable to zero.

description: Calls a subroutine and then sets a state variable to zero.

name: clear_state_variable_after_call
description: Calls a subroutine and then sets a state variable to zero.

description: Clears the lowest status bit and sets a state variable to one, calling a subroutine when the argument is nonzero. It then polls the state through a handshake loop and, if the state ends at zero, sets the status bit and moves the state to two.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:2AC6
name: run_state_handshake_poll
description: Sets a state variable to one, calling a subroutine when the argument is nonzero, then polls the state through a handshake loop. If the state ends at zero it sets the status bit and moves the state to two.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:2B36
name: write_label_letter_by_mode
description: Writes the letter N into the first byte of a record and stores either D or L at offset three, choosing D when a mode value equals one. A subroutine call runs before the writes.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:2B54
name: reset_state_and_halt
description: Clears a state variable, calls subroutines, toggles a flag and conditionally copies a value into a global before looping forever.

name: return_fixed_longword_pair
description: Returns a fixed pair of longwords, 34 and 46, with no computation.

description: Does nothing except loop endlessly with no exit, so control never returns.

name: call_then_spin_forever
description: Calls one subroutine and then loops endlessly with no exit.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:2C72
name: clear_status_bits_three_objects
description: Clears the lowest status bit on each of three objects whose pointers are held in a table, then sets two globals to zero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:2C9C
name: copy_position_words_to_globals
description: Copies two 16-bit fields at offsets 14 and 16 of an object into two global words.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:2CBA
name: rewrite_record_tag_bytes
description: If the four-character tag at the start of a record reads N30L it is rewritten as N22B, then the fourth byte is set to B and a subroutine is called. The referenced text R00A appears in the routine's facts.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:2CFA
name: reset_object_flags_and_field
description: Clears a state variable, calls three subroutines, then clears the lowest status bit of the object and zeroes the byte at offset 13.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:2D22
name: repeat_subroutine_sequence_twice
description: Runs a fixed sequence of three subroutine calls, a flag toggle and another subroutine call, repeated twice in a row.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:2D4C
name: dispatch_on_record_tag
description: Compares the four-character tag at the start of a record with N22B, N23B and N24B. Other tags reset state variables, run a handshake poll loop and store a counter, and the routine finishes by storing 70 in a global.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:2E10
name: write_c_tag_and_handshake
description: Writes the letter C at offset three of a record, calls subroutines and runs a handshake poll loop on a state variable. It then stores 70 in a global.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:2E54
name: advance_field_and_run_branch
description: Clears a global, calls subroutines and adds 50 to the 16-bit field at offset 38 of the object. It then runs one of two subroutine sequences depending on whether a global equals minus two.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:2ECA
name: set_default_timer_values
description: Calls subroutines, then sets a state byte to 15, two 16-bit timers to 200 and 250, and zeroes two globals.

description: Calls two subroutines and then toggles a flag global.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:3096
name: copy_timer_field_between_objects
description: Calls a subroutine, then copies the 16-bit field at offset 38 of one object into the same offset of the object referenced by a pointer register.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:30AC
name: process_six_table_entries
description: Loops over six entries of a table with a stride of fifteen words, calling a subroutine with each index. It then runs several subroutines and stores 70 in a global.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a].adf:ds:0:3110
name: run_four_subroutine_steps
description: Clears a state variable and then calls four subroutines in sequence.

description: Clears the lowest status bit of an object, calls six subroutines, then stores 103 in a global.

name: run_six_subroutine_steps
description: Clears a state variable, calls six subroutines in sequence and stores 103 in a global.

description: Chooses a response from an input byte by testing it against 42, 101, 25, 48 and 51, and by the current state variable. Each branch sets a state value or a result code, and the branch for 48 runs a handshake poll loop before storing values into globals.

description: The decompiler produced an empty body for this routine, so no behaviour can be recovered from the code shown.

description: Looks up the byte at three times the input index in a fixed table and stores it as a word in a global.

description: Looks up a byte from a fixed table at three times the input index and stores the result as a word in a global.
